How to play & keyboard shortcuts

Every node is one actual sticker, in one solid color. Connected rings show the sticker paths for every rotation axis. The selected axis stays bright while the other rings remain visible. Click any ring to select it, then drag along its path to turn. “Focus selected rings” dims the other axes without removing them.

Advanced jumbling unlocks six alignment stops on every edge. A turn is allowed only when every physical piece clears that edge's cutting plane. The half-turn buttons and alignment controls dim when blocked. The face map is hidden while the shape is no longer cubic and returns when the six faces are flat again. Mirror mode is available inside jumbling mode: remove the colors and restore the cube shape.

Drag the 3D puzzle to look around; scroll or pinch to zoom. Click an axis badge to select it. With the 3D view focused, arrows rotate the camera and +/− zoom. The animation slider controls all moves, randomizing, and auto solving.

Randomize applies a fresh random sequence to the current position. Auto solve opens the Constrained Solver for ordinary half-turn states, using the current arrangement. It pauses between stages and highlights protected nodes. Advanced jumbling states are not supported by this solver. Undo and Reset are always available when no move is playing. The embedded solution guide explains how to solve by hand.
